reference.name: Chinchilla empirical compute-optimal training point
reference.interpretation: Use the derived token-per-parameter ratio only as a planning reference. It is not a universal optimum or authorization threshold.

modern_overtraining_observation.name: Olmo 2 1B
modern_overtraining_observation.interpretation: Modern quality-focused open models may train far beyond the Chinchilla compute-optimal reference when downstream quality and inference amortization matter. This observation is not a 12-6 budget requirement.

promotion_invariants: Never equate parameter count, source bytes, tokenizer tokens, optimized causal loss positions, epochs, or FLOPs.
Source bytes cannot be converted into scientific token capacity until the exact tokenizer and post-pack unique-loss ledger are bound.
MECHANICS_PILOT evidence cannot promote a model to a learned scientific or quality-pretraining claim.
RESEARCH_CAMPAIGN cannot start while terminal corpus identity, shard identity, and positive unique no-replay loss capacity are absent.
QUALITY_PRETRAIN_REFERENCE is a planning comparison only and never overrides project data rights, decontamination, evaluation separation, compute authorization, or audit gates.
No materially paid cloud or GPU training is authorized by this file.
